detail.longDescription: Hey all, James here (creator of Hazumi for HN), after years of working on Hazumi for iOS/Apple Watch, I finally brought all the app's features to Web with tons more that I think you're gonna love Radar - watch any post for changes, you get a browser push notification - set a custom topic or select from what's there, when it's posted you get a browser push notification Profiles - you can view any profile and browse their latest activity, posts, comments and stats Feeds - add custom RSS feeds to your home page - add an automatically refreshing HN search feed for topics your interested in on HN Posts - each post is enriched with SEO metadata pulled from the linked site - AI summary of the story too Weekly digest - an in app weekly newsletter (automatically compiled top weekly stories and their summaries) Bookmarks - not much to say here but collect stories and organize them as you want I'd love to hear what you think, how I can improve it, what you want added Thanks! James
